Supplement: the previous optical-flow integral is preserved here, alongside PIV integrated over its own available segments.
The curves cover different horizontal locations and widths. Their integral difference therefore combines velocity differences with coverage differences.
Use horizontal_integral_vs_piv for the identical-segment comparison. Gray = masked strip; physical units and surface offset are assumed.
